item.title: A voice for change: Remembering Marlene Johnson, a pioneer in the fight for Native rights
item.description: After the passage of the Alaska Native Claims Settlement Act, Marlene Johnson went on to become one of the state's most influential Native leaders.

item.title: US Senate confirms a new judge for Alaska
item.description: Aaron C. Peterson of Anchorage, an attorney at the Department of Law, will be Alaska's next federal District Court judge. The court still has one vacant spot.

item.title: Opponents of mining site near Haines target new owner at industry conference
item.description: The campaign came the same week that Vizsla announced plans for the project for this year – and touted a formal letter of support from Gov. Mike Dunleavy.

item.title: Anchorage judge dismisses defamation lawsuit against Anchorage Daily News, Alaska Public Media
item.description: Jeremy Cubas, a former aide to Gov. Mike Dunleavy, sued Alaska Public Media, the Anchorage Daily News, Nat Herz and Curtis Gilbert last year. American Public Media, a national organization, was also named in the suit.

item.title: A Juneau jazz band wanted to make its show a fundraiser. Festival organizers say they didn’t agree to that.
item.description: This week's Dream Band show was advertised as a fundraiser for the ACLU of Alaska, but the band canceled after Juneau Jazz and Classics raised concerns.

item.title: February First Friday features ‘Capitol Crude,’ solo artist Myesha Callahan Freet at State Museum, and Unseen Ocean Collective at the JACC
item.description: Juneau Afternoon featuring "Capital Crude" author Lisa Weissler, Alaska State Museum solo artist Myesha Callahan Freet, and the Unseen Ocean Collective art show at the Juneau Arts & Culture Center.

item.title: Juneau Assembly considers school and wastewater bonds, temporary tax for next election
item.description: The temporary tax and bond packages still need to go through a few committees before the Assembly votes on whether to put them on the ballot.

item.title: Would Gov. Dunleavy’s fiscal plan solve Alaska’s long-running budget issues?
item.description: Lawmakers are scheduled to take public comment on the tax portion of Dunleavy’s plan Thursday evening.

item.title: ADF&G euthanizes mountain goat kid with contagious skin infection found on Perseverance Trail
item.description: The goat had the advanced stages of contagious ecthyma, a viral infection known as ‘orf’ when people catch it.
